title: Recipe
description: A crafting recipe (#1349): one of the material it's named after, made at the base (#695) from the materials it needs, which crafting spends from the player's profile. One file per recipe, named after the material it makes.

id.description: The material it makes, by its id (the loot slice's data/materials/).

needs.description: The materials it's made from, by id, each a whole count from 1, never the material it makes.
